research.name: Forge UI
research.note: React and Tailwind components with animated SaaS product illustrations and named WebGL noise backgrounds, plus paid Pro blocks and templates.

effects: Animated product illustration components such as Export Reactor and Notify System
Named WebGL noise backgrounds such as Noctylis (layered simplex noise with drifting warp)
Animated Form that types and checks off account fields

unverified: The free components are public at github.com/AmanShakya0018/forgeui (209 stars) under a custom all-rights-reserved license that forbids redistribution; that repository has not yet been researched as a repo candidate.
The 2026-08-27 changelog entry concerns the Pro catalog; the public repository was last pushed 2026-07-20.
